description: Tasks template for modernization plan. Generate this file alongside plan.md to track individual migration tasks.

tasks.description: Migrate the Oracle Database data tier to Azure Database for PostgreSQL, including the datasource, JPA dialect, SQL and schema compatibility, and BLOB-to-bytea photo storage conversion.
tasks.reason: The application currently uses Oracle Database with Oracle-specific JDBC driver, OracleDialect, and BLOB data types. Azure Database for PostgreSQL is the target managed relational database service on Azure, eliminating the need for self-managed Oracle infrastructure.
tasks.requirements: Replace Oracle database connectivity with PostgreSQL-compatible connectivity for Azure Database for PostgreSQL. Update datasource and JPA/Hibernate configuration, use Managed Identity for database authentication, convert Oracle-specific repository SQL and schema definitions to PostgreSQL-compatible equivalents, and migrate Oracle BLOB photo storage to PostgreSQL bytea.
